content.short: OrangeDAO is a web3 venture fund that uses DAO infrastructure to invest in early-stage crypto companies.
content.description: OrangeDAO operates as a crypto-focused venture fund guided by a circle of past, present, and future Y Combinator founders. It provides funding before and after YC participation and actively supports startups through the YC application process to gain acceptance. Beyond capital, OrangeDAO mentors leadership, helps recruit talent, and assists with customer acquisition, all aimed at accelerating growth for crypto startups.
content.meta: OrangeDAO provides a web3 venture fund that uses DAO infrastructure to invest in early-stage crypto companies. Discover OrangeDAO and other DAOs on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
